description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) of the MADLLM model under three ablation conditions — “w/o feature embedding” (purple), “w/o prompt pool” (blue), and “w/o skip embedding” (orange) — across six datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents F1 Score ranging from 60% to 100%, with tick marks at 10% intervals. For each dataset, three bars are grouped together, with the green bar (labeled “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” in the legend, though visually green and not purple) appearing first in each group — this appears to be a labeling inconsistency in the legend, as the green bar consistently represents the highest-performing variant across all datasets. The purple bar corresponds to “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” per the legend, but visually it is the second bar in each group. The blue bar (“w/o prompt pool”) and orange bar (“w/o skip embedding”) follow. Performance varies by dataset: on SMD, all variants score around 90–93%; on PSM, the green variant peaks near 97%, while the blue drops to ~77%; on SWaT, green and purple are near 91%, blue at ~83%; on SMAP, green is ~92%, purple and blue drop to ~69–70%; on MSL, green is ~87%, purple ~85%, blue ~69%; and on WADI, green is ~73%, purple drops to ~62%, blue ~64%, orange ~68%. The chart suggests that removing feature embedding (green bar, despite legend mismatch) generally preserves or enhances performance, while removing prompt pool or skip embedding degrades it, especially on SMAP and WADI. The legend contains a visual-label mismatch: the green bar is labeled as “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” in the legend, but the purple bar is labeled the same — this is likely an error, as the green bar consistently outperforms the others and likely represents the full model or a different ablation.
